description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to Torch's Lazy Tensor backend, including TSComputation and TSLoweringContext, which handle graph lowering and computation building for Torch's JIT and Lazy Tensor integration.

classes.name: TSComputation
classes.description: Represents a computation in the Torch Lazy Tensor backend, encapsulating a JIT graph and its execution context.

classes.name: TSLoweringContext
classes.description: Handles the lowering of Torch JIT nodes into Lazy Tensor operations, managing parameters, outputs, and graph construction.

methods.name: parameters_size
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters in the computation.

methods.name: parameter_shapes
methods.description: Returns the shapes of the parameters; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: parameter_names
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter names.

methods.name: result_shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the computation result; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the graph.

methods.name: AddResult
methods.description: Adds an output to the computation results.

methods.name: Lower
methods.description: Lowers a JIT node into a Lazy Tensor operation.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds the final computation object from the lowered graph.

methods.name: GetOutputOp
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the lowered operation for a given output.

methods.name: AssignOutputOp
methods.description: Assigns a lowered operation to an output.

methods.name: GetParameter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a parameter associated with data.
